description:
[Game reference] Health and raid cost of every deployable (turrets, boxes, TC, doors...). Every damageable deployable from the server files (skins folded into their base item, listed in `variants`):
`hp`, `group`, `shell` (true = extra protection against blunt/stab/slash/bullet hits from outside: doors, hatches,
high walls, the TC) and `costs` for the raid staples - `c4`, `rocket`, `satchel`, `explo` (explosive 5.56) and
`beancan` - each with `count` (direct hits / stuck charges), `damage_per_use` and `sulfur`; satchels and beancans add
`expected_lit` for their dud chance. `cheapest` is the staple that costs the least sulfur. For melee, fire, bullets
and the rest use `/raid/deployables/{shortname}`. Page: rust.wiki/raid/deployables. HP and C4/rocket/satchel/explo/beancan counts for every deployable; q= to find one. Link https://rust.wiki/raid/deployables.

group.description: One group: `door` (Doors & hatches), `wall` (Walls, gates & windows), `tc` (Tool cupboards), `defence` (Turrets & traps), `storage` (Storage), `crafting` (Crafting, ovens & farming), `electric` (Electrical), `barricade` (Barricades), `siege` (Siege weapons), `other` (Furniture & everything else).

q.description: Substring of the name or shortname.
